source: Product Manager, #experiments thread — spec of record. Copy verbatim.

quiet.name: Quiet and precise
quiet.character: You want to be trusted before you are noticed. Nothing shouts, everything is in the right place, and the work speaks for itself.

warm.name: Warm and handmade
warm.character: You want people to feel welcome and remembered. Things look touched by a person, not produced by a system.

bold.name: Bold and direct
bold.character: You want to be seen and understood in one second. Strong colour, plain words, no hedging.

scoring.rule: Each option maps to exactly one direction. Tally the eight; highest wins.
scoring.tieBreak: The direction chosen in the earliest question involved in the tie. No randomness.
scoring.encoding: Eight characters, each 'a' or 'b', question 1 first. e.g. ?a=abbabaab
